description: This Java class, ResponseBuffer, manages input buffers containing response data, processing the buffers to extract complete response lines based on CRLF delimiters. It interacts with a ResponseListener to deliver the parsed lines and uses a LinkDecoder to unpack the response strings.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer
classes.description: A class that buffers input strings and emits complete response lines to its listener when delimiters are found.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer.ResponseListener
classes.description: An interface for handling response lines emitted by ResponseBuffer.

methods.name: ResponseBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ResponseBuffer with a ResponseListener.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends input string to buffer and processes it to extract complete lines, passing each complete line to the listener after unpacking.

methods.name: hasCRLF
methods.description: Helper method to determine if the buffer contains a complete CRLF-terminated line.
